remarks: Conveniently located in a popular neighborhood near all town amenities, this updated 5-bedroom home on an acre of scenic property is ready to impress you. Very well-maintained and recently improved, this gracious, expanded home offers many upgraded amenities across a multi-level layout, which affords privacy and space for all needs including great home office options. The large living room features a re-designed modern fireplace, large window with views of the lovely setting, and an open flow into the dining room with French doors to the deck and a great flow into the recently renovated kitchen. Showcasing custom cabinetry, stone counters, a center island with seating, Thermador appliances and a bay window overlooking the back of the property, the gourmet kitchen is the wonderful hub of this bright and cheerful layout. A family room with fireplace and additional French doors open to a patio. This level includes an bedroom/office, full bath and pantry space. Upstairs, you will find the first of two primary suites, additional bedrooms, and finally the second primary suite, which is a private retreat. This spacious, luxurious area includes a vaulted ceiling bedroom, sitting room, vast walk-in closet, large bth w/ hydro tub, two sinks, lux shower. Two car garage. The home has many new windows, built-in audio, and hardwood floors in most rooms. This wonderful location is well-established, with lovely homes in a peaceful yet very convenient area close to commuting, schools, shops.
